messages:
Sam (eng): FYI - alerting: 5xx spike across hosted API after today's staged release. Error mix: 502, 503, occasional 504. Customers reporting increased latency and failed billing webhook retries. Rolling canary at 10%.
Irene (sre): Looking. Pulling canary logs & gateway proxy traces.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release/2026-03-17-staged -> 10% hosts
Dmitri (runtime): seeing repeated grpc errors from model-proxy: \"upstream read timeout\" across two pods. Stacktrace snippet:
```
model-proxy: error reading response: context deadline exceeded
proxy.go:142 handleReq -> upstream.Read() timeout
```
Sam (eng): Repro steps from support:
1) curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
2) sometimes returns 502 with body \"gateway: upstream error\"
Support-Nora (support): Multiple customers with failed invoices, started support tickets. Billing team flagged a spike in 502s during payment webhook processing.
Irene (sre): Trace shows config flag 'enable-prefetch-kv=true' was toggled in canary config. Rolling back flag on canary pods to test.
Dmitri (runtime): Confirmed a correlation: flag enables aggressive prefetch which increases concurrent upstream connections -> hitting model gateway's connection pool limits.
Sam (eng): Can we roll back canary to previous config while keeping release in staging? Need to coordinate with deployments and support.
Irene (sre): Initiating rollback on canary now.
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: release/2026-03-17-staged -> reverting config 'enable-prefetch-kv' on canary
Irene (sre): After rollback, 1-minute metrics: 5xx dropping from 12% -> 1.2% on canary hosts. Rolling out rollback to remaining staged hosts.
Support-Nora (support): Notifying affected customers + creating postmortem ticket. Triage notes attached: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-1234
Sam (eng): Next actions: add a throttling cap on prefetch (PR #452), add canary gating by 5xx rate, expand alerting to include config flips.
Dmitri (runtime): I'll put guard rails on model-proxy conn pool and add circuit breaker.
Irene (sre): Handing to oncall for monitoring rest of day. @oncall-bot please keep v2-api channel informed.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Monitoring configured: alert threshold 3% 5xx over 5m for hosted. Pager escalation unchanged.
Sam (eng): Closing here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
